content.name: Jordan Lee
content.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
content.summary: Digital marketing specialist with a York University degree and a Humber postgraduate certificate in digital marketing. Runs paid social, email and Shopify analytics for an online loose-leaf tea retailer, where a reworked welcome series and subscription offer doubled monthly recurring orders in a year.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
bullets: Manage Meta and Pinterest ads on a $6,500 monthly budget for a Shopify tea brand shipping across Canada, keeping blended ROAS above 3.5.
Redesigned the Klaviyo welcome flow and added a subscribe-and-save offer, growing recurring monthly orders from 410 to 860.
Wrote and scheduled 20+ social posts a month, including bilingual French content for Québec customers, and tracked engagement by format.
Set up GA4 e-commerce events and a weekly Looker Studio dashboard the founder uses to plan inventory around promotions.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Co-op Student
bullets: Audited local SEO for two bike shops and fixed inconsistent listings across 30 directories.
Created a spring tune-up Google Ads campaign that booked 260 service appointments in eight weeks.
Shot and edited short repair-tip videos that became the shop's most-watched Instagram content that summer.

education.degree: Ontario College Graduate Certificate, Digital Marketing

achievements.title: Subscription growth
achievements.detail: Recurring orders more than doubled within 12 months of the new welcome flow.

achievements.title: Program award
achievements.detail: Top capstone campaign in the Humber digital marketing cohort, 2023.
